source: City of Guelph, Zoning Bylaw (2023)-20790, consolidated PDF (guelph.ca/wp-content/uploads/Guelph-Zoning-Bylaw-2023.pdf, wayback 2026-01-17 snapshot; text extracted 2026-10-23). In force Feb 6 2024; parts under OLT appeal (OLT-23-000462) -> 1995 bylaw applies where appealed; partial settlement Mar 2026 not yet in interpretation doc.

RL.1.uses: single detached, semi-detached, duplex, multi-unit up to 3 units (By-law 2024-21024: up to 4 units on low-density lots, not yet consolidated)

RL.3.density_uph: VERIFY: Table 6.10 density cell not in text layer (assumed ~35 from RL.4 pattern)

RL.4.density_uph: townhouse max 35; apartment max 35 (site-specific up to 100, e.g. RL.4-18 Beechwood)

note: Old bylaw (1995)-14864 equivalents: R.4A -> RM.5/RM.6 family shift (density upgrade). RL.1 now permits multi-unit where R.1B did not (small-multi unlock).
